scientific_integrity: An unrestricted proof using exact Čech facets, relative CW homology and Hurewicz/Whitehead is supplied. The essential equivariant orientation signs are checked separately. No external certification is represented.
scientific_limitations: Valid for intrinsic graph-geometric vertex-centered Čech nerves of crown graphs with n>=3. The wedge equivalence is nonequivariant, while the top integral homology lattice is equivariant. No claim about Euclidean embeddings, stage-two inclusion maps, or absolute literature uniqueness. The all-order proof is mathematical; finite testing checks n=3 through n=6. Independent audit not performed.
title: The punctured-join Čech theorem for crown graphs and its integral symmetry module
